claims.statement: The proposed sufficient condition tau(T) >= 7 for every eligible third-shell tree is false: the n=24, p=10 six-arm tree with arm leaf counts (2,3,3,3,3,3) has tau(T)=6.
claims.scope: One exact eligible ordinary tree at n=2p+4, p=10. This refutes the cover-threshold shortcut only; its selected pointwise terms and full aggregate are negative.
claims.reason: Exact independence-polynomial coefficients establish alpha=18 and x=8, both rank guards hold, all 17 original leaves are favorable, the centers give a cover of size 6, and six disjoint pendant edges certify tau>=6. Thus tau=6. The full selected sum is -122805, so this is not a pointwise-sign or primary-aggregate refutation.

claims.statement: In the enumerated six-arm rooted family at n=2p+4 for p=10..13, the exact sorted-multiset census has one eligible row at p=10 and none at p=11,12,13; the eligible p=10 row has no positive selected pointwise term.
claims.scope: Only root-plus-six-centers trees with pendant-leaf counts d_i >= 0 and sum d_i=2p-3; finite census of 163, 235, 331, and 454 sorted multisets respectively.
claims.reason: The replay enumerates every sorted six-part nonnegative multiset in the stated finite family, computes independence polynomials and original-leaf selector values with integer arithmetic, and records all eligible rows and their local terms. No claim is made outside the stated family.

limitations: The six-arm family census is not exhaustive over all ordinary trees at these orders or over all trees with vertex-cover number at most six.
The cover-number-six example refutes only the proposed cover>=7 sufficient shortcut; its pointwise shell terms and complete selected sum are negative.
No proof or refutation of the general third-shell pointwise sign or the primary selected aggregate is obtained.
The cover-threshold example is present in the pinned common control evidence; this work independently replays its arithmetic and does not claim novelty.
